item.title: Pretty setting and area! Almost three acres in Virginia. $249,000
item.description: Pretty area of Virginia! The setting looks nice! They definitely need more interior pictures! The house was built in 1948. It is located on 2.92 acres in Stuart, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, a back patio, original wood floors, baseboards and crown moulding. It would be nice to undo some of the renovations. Looks like there are seasonal views of a nearby pond. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,040 square feet. $249,000 Contact Karen Wilson with Five Star Mountain Realty:

item.title: Ozark Mountains cabin in Arkansas. Four acres overlooking a river. $199,000
item.description: This is a nice cabin in the Ozark Mountains. It sits high above the Spring River. The cabin was built in 1937. It is located on 4.34 acres in Highland, Arkansas. The house features a covered front porch, stone work, covered upper porch, wood floors, exposed beams, stone fireplace and bead board. The kitchen and bathrooms could use some work. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,512 square feet. $199,000 Contact Jeff Stone with Coldwell Banker Ozark Real Estate Company: 870-856-3206 From the Zillow

item.description: This is a big house with five bedrooms and three bathrooms! Known as the Johnson-Woodcock-Shaffer House. It was built in 1911. It is located on .86 acre in Atkinson, North Carolina. The house features a screened in front porch, original wood floors, nice staircase, wide baseboards, french doors, crown moulding and nine fireplaces. There is an english basement with a fireplace. item.title: Original details inside! Great street in Danville, Virginia. $259,900
item.description: This house has a lot of original details inside! It’s on a great street in Danville. The house was built in 1923. It is located in Danville, Virginia. The house features a pretty staircase, original wood floors, wainscoting, wide baseboards, arched built-in bookshelves, arched entryway, chair rails and crown moulding. There is a fenced in backyard. The kitchen definitely needs some work. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 2,896 square feet. $259,900 Contact Kevin Amos with Elizabeth Ware Realtors

item.title: Oregon’s most expensive old house listing! Ranch on 51,000 acres. $54,580,000
item.description: Welcome to Oregon’s most expensive old house listing! This is a beautiful ranch. I can’t imagine having that much acreage. The main house was built in 1921. It is located on 51,087 acres in Madras, Oregon. There is an additional 15,000 of BLM grazing permits. There are multiple buildings on the property, including ranch hand houses, a dance hall, chapel and multiple barns. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 4,652 square feet. $54,580,000 From the Zillow listing: Spanning over 51,087 deeded acres
